en: [[It]] [[is]] [[impossible]] to know what life has prepared for us, so it is essential to enjoy every day.
me: to know what life has prepared for us,
so it is essential to enjoy every day.
easy: to know what life has prepared for us
삶이 우리를 위해 무엇을 준비해 두었는지 아는 것이.
so it is essential to enjoy every day
요약: 앞날은 알 수 없으니 오늘을 즐기는 게 중요하다.
notes: ① what + 불완전한 절: has prepared(준비해 두었다, prepare(준비하다))의 목적어가 빠졌으니 what(무엇을). why는 완전한 절 앞
② how + 완전한 절: time passes by quickly는 다 갖춘 절이고 '얼마나 빨리'라는 뜻 → how ○, which ✕

en: If some people sink into debt because of overspending or credit card abuse, [[is]] [[it]] solely [[their fault]]?
me: If some people sink into debt because of overspending or credit card abuse,
easy: If some people sink into debt
because of overspending or credit card abuse
요약: 빚은 과소비 때문이라도 오직 개인 탓일까?
notes: ① because of + 명사(구), because + 주어+동사(절). overspending or credit card abuse는 명사구 → because of
② what + 불완전한 절: 'what causes this kind of problem'에서 causes(일으키다)의 주어가 없으니 what(~하는 것). if ✕
